profile.headline: Senior Full Stack & AI Engineer | I build software and AI systems | Node.js, Angular, React, RAG, MCP
profile.summary:
Full stack engineer who helps teams replace manual work with software that fits how they actually run: web apps, integrations, and AI.

Developing since 2013. Angular since the 1.x days. Node.js on the back end. React for new builds. Lately, AI: RAG pipelines, agents, MCP servers, and the plumbing that keeps them reliable in production.

What I work on: 
→ Full stack web apps (Angular, React, Node.js) 
→ APIs and integrations (Stripe, Auth0, Salesforce, Twilio, Zendesk, NetSuite) 
→ Cloud and DevOps on AWS, Azure, and GCP 
→ AI and automation: RAG, agents, MCP servers

How I work: 
I understand the real problem, make a clear plan, build in small steps, test as I go, and ship with confidence. I care about code other people can pick up without a tour.

Clear systems. Better questions. The first "what if" is worth more than the first commit.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Build full stack web apps, APIs, and integrations (Angular, React, Node.js)
- Build AI agents, RAG, and AI-driven apps with Claude Code/Codex, MCP servers, and LLMs
- Lead requirements gathering, proofs of concept, and architecture so stakeholders are aligned early and delivery moves faster
positions.insights: Skills: Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Claude Code · Copilot Cowork · Model Context Protocol (MCP) · Agentic Workflows · Automation · MERN Stack
